newsitem.title: USA: Danish musician slain in NY was to be a father.
newsitem.headline: Danish musician slain in NY was to be a father.

text.p: Christoffer Burmeister, the young Danish rock musician killed in the Empire State Building shooting on Sunday, was about to become a father.

Burmeister's girlfriend, who is in Denmark, is two months pregnant, according to a statement on Tuesday by Bellevue Hospital Centre. The statement quoted his friend and fellow Bushpilots bandmember Thomas Vang as saying that Burmeister was someone who was "constantly trying new things."

Vang said Burmeister moved to the United States to pursue his music career, but also had interests ranging from Italian cooking to in-line skating, tennis and art. The 27-year-old guitarist had only recently begun focusing on songwriting, "and the new music was pouring from him," Vang said.

Another bandmember, Matthew Gross, of Montclair, N.J., remains in critical condition at Bellevue, after being shot in the head in the same shooting rampage by Ali Abu Kamal, a distraught Palestinian gunman.
